title: msgid_map duplicate check precedes IPFS write; no orphaned CIDs possible
description: reader/post/log_append.rs checks for duplicate message-ID before writing to IPFS and msgid_map. If IPFS write fails, msgid_map is never updated — a missing entry means 'CID unreachable by ID' but IPFS block may exist (recoverable by reindex). The inverse (msgid_map entry without IPFS block) would be unrecoverable. The ordering is deliberately defensive.
